notes.title: Algotica - Iteration 1 / Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Fixed:

     Achievement "Mr. Detective" now can be granted. If you already completed condition for this achievement(but didn't get achievement) you will get if automatically in Free Memory.
     Violet Terminator on the level 11 in the Old Explorer's Keep can translate Lony to another memory zone now. 
     Small fixes.
